reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction omits product origin and quality transparency.

decisions.rationale: Source supports transparent sourcing; reconstruction mismatch concerns children, not parent legitimacy.
decisions.outcome_justification: Customer gains informed purchasing decisions through traceable data.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction accurately covers wallet management and payment notifications.

decisions.rationale: Parent represents a distinct, documented outcome with no redundancy.
decisions.outcome_justification: Customer securely manages payments and handles insufficient balances independently.

reconstruction_diagnosis.rationale: Reconstruction fully covers pickup scheduling, reminders, and forfeits.
